Restarted Bing03 with paired history still fails: first point rejected then seven verified clicks, no typing. Stop after bounded failure; do not replace Fara.
Initial Bing02 type staleness has no isolated cause; do not infer every timing issue was repaired.
Current local search/window, Fara target and Holo wire/login regressions pass; Holo native login repeats the known thread-priority warning.

Every live attempt retained one native browser window; the local lifecycle regression checks six observations and three Stop/new-task cycles. Other intentional test process/window starts and ends remain.
